Compare scripting, subscriptions, editing, review, localization, and maintenance costs with the equivalent filmed workflow rather than relying on a universal savings percentage.

It can support this content, but the format does not replace expert review or clear accountability. Use approved source material, check the script and output, apply appropriate consent and disclosure practices, and provide access to the full documentation or a qualified person when needed.


-


###


AI video and human-presented footage serve different needs and can work together. AI presenters may suit repeatable explanations and localized versions, while a recognizable person may be more appropriate when personal presence matters. Choose the combination that supports the message and audience.
